requirements.statement: A customer can complete a password reset so the new password replaces the previous password.
acceptance_criteria: Given an eligible customer and a valid, unused, unexpired reset link, when the customer completes a reset with an eligible new password, then the new password works for subsequent sign-in and the previous password no longer does.

requirements.statement: The sign-in page offers a "Forgot password?" link that starts a password reset request.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-in page, when a customer selects "Forgot password?", then the password-reset request flow begins.

requirements.statement: A password-reset request returns an identical response whether the account exists or not.
acceptance_criteria: Given otherwise equivalent reset requests for an existing and a nonexistent account, when each request is submitted, then the externally observable request responses are identical.

requirements.statement: Password-reset requests are limited to five per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given five accepted reset requests for the same account in a one-hour period, when a sixth is attempted in that period, then the sixth request is not accepted as another reset request for that account.

requirements.statement: A reset link can complete at most one password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid, unexpired reset link that has completed a reset, when that link is used again, then it cannot complete another reset.

requirements.statement: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is issued.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link issued at time T, when an attempt to complete a reset with it occurs at or after T plus 30 minutes, then the link cannot complete the reset.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with one or more active sessions, when its password reset completes, then none of those sessions remains authenticated.

requirements.statement: The account owner is notified after every successful password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account owner, when each password reset for that account succeeds, then the owner is notified for that successful reset.
